description: Polish glossary of the game's own text (docs/modding/translation-handbook.md). terms: English term of glossary_en.json -> the Polish form used in every file. keep_latin: unused for a Latin-script language. style: the rules of voice and form.

style.address: Harry and Cybil: ty. Harry and Lisa: ty. Harry and Kaufmann: pan, both ways. Dahlia to everyone: ty, elevated and archaic (czyż, oto, spiesz); Harry to Dahlia: pani until the last scene, ty in the last scene. Dahlia and Kaufmann: ty. Alessa to Dahlia: mamo / mamusiu. Harry to the aliens of the UFO ending: plural (widzieliście).
style.gender: Polish past-tense verbs carry the speaker's gender: every first-person line needs its speaker (see the list of scenes in translation-handbook.md). The motel diary is written by a man, Lisa's diary by a woman, the wall writing in Alessa's room addresses a girl (Złodziejka).
style.quotes: „ ” for the [ ] of the English; the dash is the character — (U+2014), which the English writes as '='.
style.item_in_sentence: an item name inside a sentence is lower case and in the nominative: 'Jest tu <name>. Zabrać?' (plural: 'Są tu <name>.'), 'Użyto: <name>.', 'Zdobyto: <name>.'; four sentences decline the name because the verb needs a case (wsunięto <kartę z obrazkiem>, przelano do <plastikowej butelki>, polano <spirytusem odkażającym>, użyto benzyny).
style.names: foreign names are declined where Polish does it naturally (Kaufmanna, Alessy, Lisę, Flaurosa, Samaela); Cheryl and Cybil stay undeclined; the vocative is used only in Dahlia's elevated speech (Alesso).
style.units: floors are counted the Polish way (the American 2nd floor is '1. piętro', the 1st floor is 'parter'); the 3' pipe is 'długości metra'; the 10 to 15 in. of the herbal entry stay in inches (cali).
style.font: all Polish letters (ą ć ę ł ń ó ś ź ż and their capitals), „ ” and — have glyphs in the game font: nothing in this translation needs the system-font fallback.

terms.Alessa Gillespie: Alessa Gillespie (Alessy, Alessę; wołacz u Dahlii: Alesso)
terms.K. Gordon: K. Gordon (nieodmienne; na kluczu w cudzysłowie)
terms.Lion / Woodman / Scarecrow: Lew / Drwal / Strach na Wróble (klucz Lwa, klucz Drwala, klucz Stracha na Wróble)
terms.Key of [..]: Klucz „..” (mianownik: imiona duchów, „K. Gordon”); klucze z krainy Oz w dopełniaczu, bez cudzysłowu
terms.Handgun / Hunting rifle / Shotgun: Pistolet / Karabin myśliwski / Strzelba (naboje do pistoletu, do karabinu, do strzelby)
terms.There is a X. Take it?: Jest tu <X>. Zabrać? (liczba mnoga: Są tu <X>.)
